decide.ts: tt.decideAnswer("Is this a complaint?", "I demand a refund today")

choose.ts: tt.chooseAnswer({choose: "Which team owns this?", options: ["billing", "shipping"]}, "please route this ticket")

tag.ts: tt.tagAnswer({tag: "Which topics apply?", labels: ["refund", "shipping"]}, "the refund and the shipping")

score.ts: tt.scoreAnswer({score: "How urgent is this?", levels: ["Routine.", "Soon.", "Immediate."]}, "maybe later")

filter.ts: tt.filterAnswer("Is this a complaint?", ["good morning", "I demand a refund today"])

rank.ts: tt.rankAnswer("Is this a complaint?", ["good morning", "I demand a refund today"], { top: 1 })

find.ts: tt.findAnswer("Which line asks for money back?", ["I want a refund", "good morning"]).then(answer => answer.value)

annotate.ts: tt.annotateAnswer({ version: 1, questions: { wants_refund: { decide: "Does the customer ask for a refund?" }, urgency: { score: "How urgent is this?", levels: ["Routine.", "Soon.", "Immediate."] } } }, ["maybe later"]).then(rows => rows.map(row => row.value))

recognize.ts: tt.recognizeAnswer(tt.constructor.recognizeQuestion({person:"A person's name."}), "Le café 😀 Maria Chen arrived.").then(rows => rows[0].value.entities.map(entity => entity.text))

relate.ts: tt.relateAnswer(tt.constructor.relateQuestion([{name:"works_for",source:"person",target:"organization",either:false}]), [{"name": "Iris Vangelis works for Kestrel Logistics, handling regional accounts.", "kind": "person"}, {"name": "Noor Haddad works for Brookline Freight, handling regional accounts.", "kind": "person"}, {"name": "Petr Novak works for Grayline Foundation, handling regional accounts.", "kind": "person"}, {"name": "Rosa Iglesias works for Fenwick Press, handling regional accounts.", "kind": "person"}, {"name": "Tariq Mensah works for Hull Analytics, handling regional accounts.", "kind": "person"}, {"name": "Kestrel Logistics, a freight and logistics firm.", "kind": "organization"}, {"name": "Brookline Freight, a freight and logistics firm.", "kind": "organization"}, {"name": "Grayline Foundation, a freight and logistics firm.", "kind": "organization"}, {"name": "Fenwick Press, a freight and logistics firm.", "kind": "organization"}, {"name": "Hull Analytics, a freight and logistics firm.", "kind": "organization"}]).then(answer => answer.value.length)
